data.body: **[P2] Do not publish the cross-loader bridge for a non-durable sampler.** When a visible global provider's sampler is not any `DurableSampler`—for example, a later customizer replaced it—this omits the context carrier, but `startDurableSpan` still publishes the system-property carrier. Since that sampler never consumes it, the property remains live through synchronous processors; a processor starting a span on another provider with `DurableSampler` can consume the stale intent and override that span's sampling policy. Gate `openScope` on the provider having a local or cross-loader `DurableSampler` (or the hidden-agent path), mirror the fix in `ExecutionOtelPlugin`, and add an opaque-sampler two-provider test.
